title: Fantasy Animation Screenwriting Mentor Needed
desc:
I’m a 15-year-old storyteller who lives and breathes fantasy and dreams of turning my ideas into polished animation scripts that speak to a teen audience. I already write short premises and character sketches but now I need a seasoned animation screenwriter who can guide me step-by-step—from tightening structure and pacing to mastering dialogue that jumps off the page.

Here’s what I hope to gain:

• A clear, age-appropriate roadmap to industry-standard screenplay format for animation  
• Weekly live or recorded feedback on my pages (Google Docs or Final Draft both work for me)  
• Practical exercises that strengthen world-building, stakes and character arcs aimed at teen viewers  
• Honest insight on pitching an animated project once my pilot draft is ready  

I’m flexible on whether we frame the lessons around film, TV or web-series conventions; the most important thing is learning how to make a fantasy concept translate visually on screen. If you have produced or optioned scripts, especially in animation, I’d love to hear about it when you respond.  

Please include a short note on your approach to mentoring young writers, a sample of your own work, and an outline of how you would structure our first month together.

title: Web Hosting Affiliate Sellers Needed
desc:
I run a web-hosting company and I’m opening our affiliate program to a handful of motivated partners who can actually drive completed sales—not just clicks or sign-ups. Once we connect in chat I’ll give you the site URL, commission structure, and your unique tracking links.

You’re free to promote any way you like, but the core channels I expect you to lean on are social media marketing, email marketing, content marketing through blogs or articles, and of course your own personal network if that brings results. Feel free to combine tactics or test new angles, so long as the traffic you send converts into paid hosting plans or related add-ons; partial or abandoned purchases won’t count.

I’ll supply creatives, copy points, and performance stats so you can optimise. You’ll supply the traffic, the finished conversions, and regular reports pulled from our affiliate dashboard so we both see the same numbers.

Payouts release automatically once transactions clear, and I have no cap on earnings—only on wasted clicks. If you already have an engaged audience that trusts your tech recommendations, let’s chat and get your links live today.

title: Modern Brand Kit Design
desc:
I’m refreshing my online presence and need a complete brand kit built around a clean, modern look. The core pieces I’m after are a distinctive logo, a cohesive color palette, and clear typography guidelines that will live first on my website and later roll out across other touchpoints.

The logo should feel contemporary—think balanced geometry, crisp lines, and an uncomplicated mark that scales well on screen. From there, I’ll rely on you to craft a palette that complements the logo and provides enough flexibility for headings, backgrounds, and accents. Finally, I want typography rules that pair a web-safe primary typeface with supporting styles so I can keep every headline, paragraph, and CTA consistent.

Deliverables:
• Vector logo files (AI, SVG, PNG, JPG)  
• Color palette with HEX, RGB, CMYK values  
• Typography guide detailing font families, weights, and usage notes  
• A short PDF style sheet summarising everything for quick reference

I’m comfortable with you working in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or Figma—whatever lets you deliver neatly organised source files. Let me know how you’d approach the concept phase and roughly how many iterations you expect to reach final sign-off.

title: Automate Inventory Management System Testing
desc:
Develop automated test case to test the workflow of an inventory & material management system. The system is a webapplication. 

The Test Scenario as a summary is
A Property has a warehouse where spare part inventory is stored. Maintenance requests consume the inventory in the Property warehouse. 
A material request scans the warehouse for spare parts which are under the reorder level and prepares the list of spare parts and the min qty that needs to be ordered.
The ordering process is outside the system. The spare parts once received are updated in the central warehouse inventory.
The material fulfillment team then updates the Material Request list with the received materials. The inventory in the central warehouse is reduced. When the spare parts in the Material request list is delivered at the warehouse in the property the inventory there is increased.

Different scenarios have to be chalked out, data created and automated test script created to run the test cases.

title: Build Intraday NSE Trading Algo
desc:
I want my proprietary intraday strategies on the National Stock Exchange translated into clean, production-ready Python. Your code should accept live market feeds, apply my logic in real time, and place orders automatically through the broker API I’ll provide. Before we go live, I also need a back-test harness so we can replay historical NSE ticks and verify performance side-by-side with the live engine.

Because the strategies already exist on paper, the task is purely technical: translate rules into well-structured functions, handle edge cases such as partial fills or data lags, log every decision, and expose a simple config file where I can fine-tune parameters without touching the source. Pandas, NumPy, ta-lib, and a mainstream broker SDK such as Kite or FYERS are the tools I usually see for jobs like this—use what you’re comfortable with as long as the final script behaves deterministically and is easy to audit.

I’m based in Bangalore and daily collaboration is simpler if you’re nearby, but I’m open to anyone within India who can hop on quick calls during market hours. Please share a short note on your past intraday or automated trading work on NSE, a GitHub link or executable demo of a back-test you built, and how long you’d need for:

• First working prototype with hard-coded parameters  
• Completed back-testing module with sample report  
• Final production version ready for live orders  

I’ll supply the strategy rules under NDA the moment we start.

title: Resume Writing & Data Entry Assistant
desc:
I need an experienced Indian freelancer who can streamline two areas for me. First, I want my current résumé transformed into a sharp, ATS-friendly document that captures my skills and achievements in clear, concise language. Second, I have ongoing digital tasks—mainly data entry into Google Sheets and Excel—that must be handled accurately and on schedule.

You should feel comfortable polishing professional profiles, choosing the right keywords, and formatting a résumé for both PDF and editable Word delivery. On the data side, attention to detail is critical: the information you’ll enter comes from varied sources, so consistency checks and basic cleaning will be part of the workflow.

Deliverables  
• A finished résumé in PDF and DOCX formats, fully optimized for applicant tracking systems  
• Clean, well-structured spreadsheets with 100 % of records cross-verified against the source data  

I will share source documents, log-in credentials, and style preferences once we start. If you have prior examples of résumés you’ve revamped and can demonstrate fast, accurate data entry, let’s move forward.

title: Industrial Facility Load Calculation & SLD
desc:
I’m advancing the design of an industrial-use building and I need a qualified electrical engineer to wrap up two critical documents: a full electrical load calculation and a clean, code-compliant single-line diagram.  

Scope  
• Load calculation – demand factors applied, panel schedules filled out, conductor and protective-device sizing referenced to the current NEC (or the governing standard you normally use for U.S. industrial facilities).  
• Single-line diagram – clear equipment hierarchy from utility service down to the smallest distribution panel, showing breakers, feeders, grounding and fault levels. I’ll supply the architectural layout, equipment list and utility data the moment we start; you turn that into professional-grade PDF outputs plus the editable source file (Excel for the calc sheet, AutoCAD or similar for the SLD).  

What helps me choose quickly  
When you reply, highlight projects where you produced industrial electrical calculations and SLDs—give me a line or two on the plant size, voltage class and any special constraints you handled. That practical experience will weigh more than a generic portfolio.  

Timeline & checkpoints  
Draft load calc first so we can lock feeder sizes, then the annotated SLD; I’m aiming to review within five business days of each submission and wrap the whole package soon after.  

If you’re confident working with industrial loads, NEC tables and clear diagramming standards, let’s get started.

title: AI Business Automation Specialist
desc:
I need an AI expert to automate customer inquiries on WhatsApp and handle multiple tasks on my website. 

Requirements:
- On WhatsApp, AI should manage customer inquiries.
- On the website, AI should handle:
  - Customer inquiries
  - Order processing
  - Payment processing

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proficiency in AI tools and platforms
- Experience in automating business processes
- Strong understanding of customer service automation

Looking for someone who can streamline these processes efficiently.

title: Creative Handwritten Presentation Notes
desc:
I have a short slide-deck for an upcoming client presentation and I’d like the key talking points rewritten in a visually engaging, hand-written format. Think of something that feels spontaneous and artistic rather than rigid—distinct lettering styles, varied stroke widths and playful spacing—yet still 100 % legible at a glance.  

Please add subtle highlighting or underlining to draw the viewer’s eye to the core concepts; no other embellishments are needed. I’ll supply the final text (roughly three pages). You’ll return high-resolution scans or a clean digital tablet export (PDF + PNG) that I can drop straight into my slides.  

I’ll sign off once the wording is complete, the highlights are balanced, and everything looks crisp when projected on a 16:9 slide.
